items: 🎁85pcs Furniture for 6 Rooms and Dollhouse– this package contains 6 sets of dollhouse furniture for living room, bathroom, kitchen, kids & baby room, bedroom and patio. Bright green color will be good for eyes when kids playing with it for a long time. With a complete set of furniture, kids can conduct role plays and family life drills for a long time in the spirit of Montessori Education.

🎁DELUXE WOODEN FURNITURE SET FOR TODDLERS AND KIDS – this dollhouse furniture set features cute and vivid accessories, there are real drawers on the living room cabinet, kitchen cabinet, dressing table and wash basin. The closet door can be opened, the refrigerator door can be opened, the toilet lid also can be opened and closed. The lovely tent & rocking horse are unique-particular. These exquisite accessories bring more fun when playing.

🎁PREMIUM QUALITY SAFETY FOR KIDS TO PLAY – all the furniture accessories are made of polished beech wood and plastic, no sharp edges, smooth enough to protect children when playing. Fully tested to the highest U.S. ASTM F 963-11 and European EN71 toys safety standards, BPA free. To make sure your child play safe is our No. 1 priority!

🎁COMPATIBLE WITH OTHER BRAND DOLLHOUSE – Kids can decorate their own dollhouse with this dollhouse furniture set, creating a dreamy house, inspiring the imagination and creativity when playing. Boys and girls will unlock more play ways.

🎁IDEAL GIFT CHOICE – This deluxe wooden furniture set is easy to fascinate kids and create fun times for hours. It is an ideal birthday Christmas new year surprise for any toddler, providing them with endless opportunities to build, decorate, and create their dream home. They also come with a solid and storage box to make them easier to store or for portable play.
